title: Platform blocks in India (Access Now STOP)

metadata.note: 65 India platform-blocking events documented by Access Now and the #KeepItOn coalition's STOP project. Distinct from connectivity shutdowns: these are blocks of specific apps/services. Used as evidence; not all rows are charted.

rows.platform: TikTok, WeChat, and 57 other Chinese-made apps
rows.scope: It affected locations in more than one state, province, or region
rows.justification: National security/ Counter-terrorism
rows.legal_method: Section 69A of the Information Technology Act, 2000; Information Technology (Procedure and Safeguards for Blocking of Access of Information by Public) Rules 2009 (https://pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=1635206&reg=3&lang=1)
